We use various factors for recommending products to you. The importance or weighting of a factor may change over time. When you use the search engine on Temu, search results are ranked by default according to their “Relevance”.

The following factors are generally considered more significant than others in determining which product will be of most relevance to you:

 •  The relevance of product listings to your search keywords;
 •  Your browsing, searching and purchasing history on Temu;
 •  Time you spent viewing specific product listings on Temu.

The following factors can also influence how products are recommended on Temu:

 •  Your account profile (such as your country/region if recorded in your account profile);
 •  Your approximate location based on your technical information (e.g. IP address);
 •  The popularity of products on Temu;
 •  Current deals campaigns; and
 •  Product prices.

Product ranking is also influenced by the price paid by sellers to Temu to receive a higher ranking for a specific offer. Where applicable, these offers appear with the label "AD" and are ranked higher than offers that have not been paid for. Thus, when displaying offers with similar relevance, we may show offers that have been paid for in the search results page before offers that have not been paid for.

The products that we recommend changes over time in accordance with the above criteria. For example, the content we recommend will change based on your purchase of different products, browsing for new products and similar activities by other users.

You can also change the layout of product listings by selecting one of the following alternative sorting criteria:

 •  Best sellers
 •  Most Recent
 •  Price low to high
 •  Price high to low

Regardless of the sorting option selected, you can also refine your search by filtering the results based on features of the products, such as colour, review ratings, price and specific product details.
